description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'AbstractApplication' that serves as a base for implementing Spring Boot applications in the Eclipse Hono project. It manages service factories, deployment of verticles, and provides lifecycle hooks for deploying services within Vert.x.

classes.name: AbstractApplication
classes.description: A base class for implementing Spring Boot applications that deploy service verticles in Vert.x, managing service factories and deployment lifecycle.

methods.name: preFlightCheck
methods.description: Performs validation before starting the application; throws exception if no service factories are configured.

methods.name: addServiceFactories
methods.description: Adds a set of service factory objects to the application for creating service instances.

methods.name: deployRequiredVerticles
methods.description: Hook method to deploy prerequisite verticles before main service deployment; default returns a succeeded future.

methods.name: deployServiceVerticles
methods.description: Deploys service instances generated by the registered service factories across specified number of instances.

methods.name: preDeploy
methods.description: Hook invoked before deploying each service instance; default implementation does nothing.

methods.name: postDeploy
methods.description: Hook invoked after a service instance has been successfully deployed; default does nothing.

methods.name: deployVerticles
methods.description: Coordinates the deployment of core, required, and service verticles in sequence.
